messages:
alexa: Quick poll  spring picnic next Thursday at River Park 12:30pm? casual, bring a dish to share. Who's up for it? :sun_with_face: :salad:

tom: In! I can bring a big batch of fried rice (veg + egg).

rita: Sounds great. I'm GF so will bring a quinoa salad. Any allergies to note?

sam: I can bring drinks. Soda + sparkling water ok? also can bring a small bluetooth speaker.

lunchbot: Poll created: "Confirm date" options: Thu 4/15, Fri 4/16, Thu 4/22  vote with :one: :two: :three:. (poll id 9567)

rita: voted :one: (Thu 4/15)

tom: voted :one: (Thu 4/15)

sam: voted :three: (Thu 4/22)

alexa: No strong feelings, leaning 4/15. @rita noted GF, anyone else? I'll make a quick signup sheet.

calendarbot: Tentative event created: "Redwood picnic" 2026-04-15 12:30 - 13:30. RSVP required.

rita: heads up: the east lot closes at 12:45, best to carpool or use the north gate entrance.

tom: I have space for 2 in my car if anyone needs a ride.

sam: can remote folks join via a picnic photo thread? maybe we take a group selfie and drop in #lunch-plans.

alexa: yes! we'll do a photo drop and a short live video for remote folks. I'll set a reminder.

lunchbot: Reminder set: "Picnic final headcount" 2026-04-14 10:00 (local)

rita: i'll label containers for GF/contains-gluten. tom, can you note if your rice has soy? some people avoid soy.

tom: noted. mine will be soy-free version, I'll mark it.

sam: bringing disposable plates + a small cooler. if anyone wants to bring blankets comment here.

alexa: i'll bring two blankets and some citronella candles just in case.

tom: excited! see you all there :smile:

rita: thanks for organizing alexa :)

alexa: happy to. final: sign up on the sheet by Tue EOD so we can estimate pizza fallback if it rains.

calendarbot: Event updated: attendees 5/20 confirmed, waiting on others."
